title: This Fish Chokes Sharks With Slime in Half a Second

scenes.text: This fish can fill a shark's mouth with slime in half a second.
It's a hagfish, and it has hundreds of pores along its body.
Tiny threads unravel into slime that swells up to 10,000 times its size.
It clogs a predator's gills, and the predator gags and swims away.
Hagfish have been doing this for at least 300 million years.
One hagfish can turn a bucket of water into jelly.
A fish that wins by choking its attacker.

description:
